questions.q: What actually determines a segment's accounting behavior in Oracle Fusion — its name or its label?
options: Its label (qualifier), regardless of what the segment is named
Neither; behavior is hardcoded by segment position only
Only the value set attached to it
Its name, since labels are purely cosmetic
questions.explain: The label assigned to a segment, not its display name, is what tells Oracle Fusion's accounting engine how to treat that segment.

questions.q: How many primary balancing segments must a chart of accounts have?
options: Zero; primary balancing is optional
Exactly one, since the primary balancing segment label is mandatory
Exactly three, one for each balancing level
As many as there are legal entities
questions.explain: The primary balancing segment label is mandatory, and every chart of accounts must have exactly one segment carrying it.

questions.q: When does the cost center label become effectively required, even though it is optional at the general chart-of-accounts level?
options: Only for companies with more than one currency
Never; cost center is always purely optional with no consequences
When the business uses Oracle Assets or Oracle Expenses, both of which expect a cost center segment to exist
Only when using a secondary ledger
questions.explain: Oracle Assets (for depreciation and additions) and Oracle Expenses (for approval limits) both expect a cost center segment, making it effectively required in practice.

questions.q: What does the natural account label classify?
options: Which legal entity owns the transaction
Which currency the transaction was entered in
Which department incurred an expense
Which of the five fundamental account types (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense) a transaction belongs to
questions.explain: The mandatory natural account label classifies transactions into the fundamental accounting types, independent of company or department.

questions.q: What is the one hard restriction on a segment carrying the intercompany label?
options: It must always be the first segment in the structure
It cannot also carry any of the three balancing segment labels, and its values must mirror the primary balancing segment
It can never be used alongside a natural account segment
It must use a different chart of accounts structure entirely
questions.explain: The intercompany label is explicitly incompatible with any balancing label, and its value set must match the primary balancing segment's values.
